metadata.projection: Local WGS84 tangent-plane scale at origin
metadata.boundary_kind: OSM mapped campus perimeter; generalized community outline
metadata.positional_accuracy: No surveyed ground control or independently verified absolute accuracy. Centimetre storage is numerical rounding only.
metadata.diagram: Campus diagrams identify named blocks and access roads. Only additions with visible October 2026 imagery evidence are modelled.
metadata.height_policy: Only documented building heights or floor counts are supplied. Heights inferred by 3D authoring are illustrative.
metadata.roads_policy: OSM centre lines with width estimates from class or lanes unless a numerical width was mapped.
metadata.water_policy: Pond within the boundary plus nearby mapped water polygons tagged context; marine shore is a separate coastline array.
metadata.ring_policy: poly and boundary are open rings (implicit closing edge); holes are arrays of open courtyard/void rings.

south.reference: Image pixel centres from upper left; numeric road coordinates are community OSM values
south.note: Diagram-to-map residuals only; this does not assess positional error against surveyed ground truth.

north.reference: Image pixel centres from upper left; numeric road coordinates are community OSM values
north.note: Diagram-to-map residuals only; this does not assess positional error against surveyed ground truth.

metadata.supplemental_accuracy: Satellite roof outlines are generalized from 10 m pixels. Roof edges, building subdivisions, and dates of opening have additional unquantified uncertainty.
metadata.supplemental_note: The eastern library forecourt shows paving and landscaping on the fall image; a permanent pool on the axis was not confirmed. Legal campus lines and survey ground control are unavailable.
